messages:
Julia: Heads-up — open PR to adjust API behavior for model selection. main changes: new top-level param `model_select` (enum), and optional `route_tier` hint that influences fallback ordering. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234
Omar: thanks. can you summarize compatibility impact for old clients that only send `model_id`?
Julia: sure — default fallthrough keeps previous semantics: if `model_id` present, it is authoritative. `model_select` is additive and only used when `model_id` is omitted. we will still return the `served_model` field in response.
Kevin: quick q — if `route_tier` is provided, does it override region-based routing? e.g., `route_tier=dedicated` should prefer dedicated pool even if region mismatch?
Julia: good catch. behavior is: `route_tier` acts as a hint. routing policy still enforces region affinity first. we only prefer a different tier if latency/capacity tradeoff passes our policy thresholds. documented in PR description.
Maria: pinging @Omar and @Kevin for code review — also added integration tests for legacy clients and a compatibility smoke test. CI: PlatformCI queued the canary runs.
PlatformCI: Canary job #457 queued for pr/1234, target env: canary-us-west. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/ci/457
Omar: skimming PR — looks good. a couple nit comments inline about error codes when fallback happens. we should ensure `fallback_reason` string is present for observability.
Julia: yes `fallback_reason` included. current values: `no_capacity`, `model_incompatible`, `region_unavailable`, `tier_mismatch`. Are those ok?
Kevin: prefer `model_incompatible` -> `incompatible_arch`? might be useful to distinguish model architecture mismatch vs quant/format mismatch.
Maria: agree — split helps triage. also request to include `served_model_version` (semver string) in responses so clients can assert deterministic behavior.
Julia: added `served_model_version` to PR. also added a lightweight schema in api-spec.md and a jsonschema test. snippet: ```json
{
  "served_model": "redwood/ggml-1.3",
  "served_model_version": "v1.4.2",
  "fallback_reason": "no_capacity"
}
```
Omar: how are we handling older SDKs that assume responses don't have extra fields? will this break them?
Julia: we validated: SDKs ignore extra fields. All official SDKs have permissive parsing. we will add a note to changelog and a small migration note in SDK release.
Kevin: request: add one more test for mixed hints: `model_select=best_effort` + `route_tier=dedicated` when dedicated pool is under heavy load; ensure fallback to hosted is logged and `fallback_reason` is `no_capacity`.
Julia: added test case — thanks. also added rollout plan: feature-flagged default off, enable for 10% of traffic for two days, monitor `fallback_rate` and error rates. will escalate if anomalies.
Maria: LGTM from me once CI passes. Omar?
Omar: LGTM with one small comment on naming (in PR).
Julia: thanks — merging when canary green. will follow up with rollout notes in #eng-release. :tada:
